title: Tour Global Workflow Settings
blurb: Account-wide controls that apply across your workflows, like pausing them over the holidays.

steps.title: Open Global Workflow Settings
steps.body: Click **Global Workflow Settings** at the top.

steps.title: Pause workflows on set dates
steps.body: Under **Pause Workflow** you choose date ranges when selected workflows stop sending. Handy for the Christmas shutdown or a long weekend.

steps.title: How pauses work
steps.body: You can add up to 15 date ranges. Each range can be up to 15 days long, and only published workflows can be paused. Tick the yearly repeat option for holidays that come round every year.

steps.title: Per-workflow settings live elsewhere
steps.body: Sender name, quiet hours and re-entry rules are set inside each workflow, on its **Settings** tab.

steps.title: Next step
steps.body: Next: try **Pause workflows over the holidays** from the Guide.
